project.name: cc-dump
project.tagline: Transparent HTTP proxy for Claude Code API traffic. Real-time Textual TUI with system-prompt diff tracking, HAR recording, and replay.

hero.code:
# Terminal 1: start cc-dump
$ cc-dump
Listening on: http://127.0.0.1:54321

# Terminal 2: point Claude Code at it
$ ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:54321 claude

# All API traffic now flows through cc-dump and is displayed in the TUI:
#  • request/response framing with model, max_tokens, stream flag, tool count
#  • system prompts get color-coded tracking tags ([sp-1], [sp-2], …)
#  • unified diffs render inline whenever a tracked prompt changes between requests
#  • HAR file is written to ~/.local/share/cc-dump/recordings/ for later replay

highlights.title: Real-time streaming display
highlights.description: API responses stream into the TUI as they arrive. Request framing, message roles, content summaries, and tool correlation are all live.

highlights.title: System-prompt diff tracking
highlights.description: Prompts are content-addressed and assigned color-coded tags (sp-1, sp-2, …). When a tracked prompt changes between requests, a unified diff renders inline.

highlights.title: Cache-zone analysis
highlights.description: Combines request and response into a single turn view with cache-zone analysis — see which fragments of your prompt got cached and how the cache evolves.

highlights.title: 3-level visibility
highlights.description: Every content category cycles between Existence (·), Summary, and Full via number keys. Read at the density you actually want.

highlights.title: Recording and replay
highlights.description: HAR files are the source of truth for events. cc-dump writes them automatically; --replay reloads a session and the proxy keeps capturing new traffic on top.

highlights.title: Forward and reverse proxy modes
highlights.description: Default mode targets api.anthropic.com directly. Pass --target "" to switch to forward-proxy mode and inspect any HTTP API your tooling talks to.

quickstart.code:
# Install
uv tool install -e .

# Or with the optional tmux integration (split-pane CLI launching, auto-zoom):
uv tool install -e ".[tmux]"

# Run the proxy (port is OS-assigned by default and printed on startup)
cc-dump

# Point Claude Code at it
ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:<PORT> claude

# Replay a previous session
cc-dump --replay latest

# Browser mode (textual-serve)
cc-dump-serve   # then open http://localhost:8000
